Venue: Gate
Headline: Weekend Power Station: Register to Claim 75 XRP, Trade to Earn Another 150 XRP

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Weekend Power Station is now open for a limited time. Register for a chance to claim the 75 XRP lucky gift, complete futures trading over the weekend to unlock check-in rewards, and share a total pool of 2,000 XRP. Trade for a chance to receive an additional 150 XRP grand prize.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 28, 2026, 00:00 – November 29, 2026, 23:00 (UTC)
## Event 1: Registration Lucky Gift, 75 XRP per Person
The 150th, 1,500th, 5,500th, 7,500th users to register for this event will each receive 75 XRP.
Note: Winners of Event 1 must complete a futures trade of any amount during the campaign period to claim their rewards.
## Event 2: Weekend Check-In, Share 2,000 XRP
During the event, users can claim 0.5 XRP for every $10,000 in Futures trading volume. Each user can claim once per day. Rewards are automatically credited. The total prize pool is 2,000 XRP and is available while supplies last.
## Event 3: Trading Sprint, Claim Up to 150 XRP
During the event, users with Futures trading volume ≥ $1,000 can enter the lucky draw. Users who reach multiple trading volume tiers can enter the lucky draw for each eligible tier. If selected in multiple tiers, only the reward for the highest tier will be issued.
Note: The button text for Event 3 is fixed and will not change after tasks are completed.
≥ $1,000 | 7 XRP per person | Select 1,000 Users
≥ $10,000 | 75 XRP per person | Select 100 Users
≥ $100,000 | 150 XRP per person | Select 5 Users
## Important Notes
- All participants must click [Join Now] to register and complete Identity Verification before the event ends to claim rewards.
- Trading Volume = Buy Amount + Sell Amount. During the USD1 futures trading pair fee discount promotion, futures trading volume for the relevant promotional pairs will be calculated at 50%. Event 2 check-in counting period: Each day from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC) counts as one check-in day.
- Rewards for this event will be distributed as XRP spot tokens. Event 2 rewards will be credited automatically after tasks are completed, on a first-come, first-served basis. Rewards for Events 1 and 3 will be credited to users' accounts within 14 business days after the event ends.
- Market makers, corporate accounts, and institutional accounts are not eligible to participate in this event.
- Gate will review account activity, transactions, and fund transfers during the event. Violations include participating repeatedly through multiple accounts, identity impersonation or submission of false verification information, wash trading or matched trading, circular transfers of on-chain funds, coordinated reward abuse, repeated fund transfers, and any other activities that compromise the fairness of the event. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users found to have engaged in such violations from receiving rewards.
- In the event of any discrepancy between the translated version and the original English text, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation.
- Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions cannot use all or part of the services, including participation in this event, game, or competition. For details on restricted regions, please read User Agreement . Please note that we do not intend to solicit or market to customers in such restricted regions.
